description: This file contains a PHP trait 'RequestTrait' that provides common behavior for HTTP request objects, including methods for handling request target, HTTP method, and URI, intended for internal use within the 'Nyholm\Psr7' namespace.

methods.name: getRequestTarget
methods.description: Returns the request target, defaulting to '/' if not set, supplemented by URI path and query.

methods.name: withRequestTarget
methods.description: Sets a new request target string after validating it's a string with no whitespace, returning a new instance.

methods.name: getMethod
methods.description: Returns the HTTP method as a string.

methods.name: withMethod
methods.description: Sets a new HTTP method after validating it's a string, returning a new instance.

methods.name: getUri
methods.description: Returns the URI object associated with the request.

methods.name: withUri
methods.description: Assigns a new URI object, optionally preserves the Host header, and returns a new instance.

methods.name: updateHostFromUri
methods.description: Updates the Host header based on the URI's host and port, ensuring the header is correctly set.
